themes.description: Users are frustrated with various application functionality issues such as slow downloads, errors, connection timeouts, and failed transactions. They are unable to perform basic operations like adding funds, withdrawing money, and purchasing stocks. This is affecting their trading experience and overall trust in the application.
themes.business_impact: High failure rates in critical transactions may lead to revenue loss and damage to brand reputation.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The root cause may be a combination of technical issues such as outdated code, poor maintenance, and inefficient testing processes.
themes.action_plan: • Implement thorough root cause analysis and implement technical debt repayment. Enhance testing processes, automate testing and deployment, and engage with the community to gather input.

themes.description: Users are unable to load charts or view data due to various issues such as charts not opening, loading slowly, or displaying incorrect data. This leads to frustration and difficulty in trading or making investment decisions.
themes.business_impact: This issue affects the user's ability to make informed trading decisions, which may lead to losses or missed opportunities. It also impacts the overall user experience and may result in a negative review of the product.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: A potential root cause could be a bug in the chart rendering engine or an issue with the data retrieval process. This might be due to a recent update or change in the underlying system.
themes.action_plan:
• Investigate and identify the root cause of the chart loading issue.
• Collaborate with the Android Eng and Core Product teams to resolve the issue.
• Develop and implement a fix to prevent chart data from loading correctly.

themes.description: Users are experiencing performance issues with the app, including lags, freezes, and slow loading times, affecting their overall experience.
themes.business_impact: Highly frequent crashes and poor performance could lead to loss of user trust, churn, and negative word-of-mouth, ultimately impacting user acquisition and retention.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Insufficient optimization of the app's architecture and resource management may be contributing to the performance issues.
themes.action_plan:
• Optimize app architecture and resource management, conduct thorough code reviews to identify any bottlenecks, and implement memory caching to improve performance
• Identify and address any compatibility issues with newer hardware or software
• Conduct usability testing to ensure smoothness and responsiveness
